main_text.p: שִׁיט m. Remus: מְשׁוּט m. Idem.
שׁוּט Declinare: שָׂטִים שִׁטִּים Declinantes, & cum Samech, סָטִים.
שׁוּךְ m. מְשִׂכָּה f. Sepes, Sepimentum.
שִׂכָּה f. Ramus, ab usu in sepibus.

שִׂכִּים m. שְׂכּוֹת f. Vepres, spinae, sic quoq; dicta, quod ad sepimenta adhibentur. Posfiremum etiam Hamos, Harpagones significat, ut & סִיר & חוֹחַ, quae sunt quoque spinarum vocabula. Significatum hinc habent, formam autem a שָׂכָךְ.
שׂוּם Ponere, Apponere, Adhibere, Componere, Reponere, Statuere, Constituere.

Hiphil הִשִּׂים idem. Hophal הוּשַׂם Poni, Apponi. Chald. idem: Praeter. שָׂם Pofuit: שָׂמַת שָׂם Constituerat eum: Propofuifti edictum: Partic. שִׂים proponitur: וְשִׂמְ Et impofitus est. Imper. שִׂימוּ Proponite. Ithpehal Partic. מִתְשַׂם Apponitur, Esr. 5.8. Fut. יִתָּשֵׂם Ponatur, Esr.4.21: יִתְשָׂמוּן Ponentur, Dan.2.5.

page.notes: The Hebrew and Latin are read at scan resolution; several pointed Hebrew forms, especially in the Latin-Hebrew mixed lines and the top running head, are uncertain and may contain errors. Words in the Hebrew lines marked by a dot and the stray final line were not fully verified.
